args: _C="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"; _E="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; _CANDIDATES=(); [ -n "$_E" ] && _CANDIDATES+=("$_E"); _CANDIDATES+=("$PWD/plugin" "$PWD"); while IFS= read -r _DIR; do _CANDIDATES+=("$_DIR"); done < <(ls -dt "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/claude-mem-local/claude-mem"/[0-9]*/ "$HOME/.codex/plugins/cache/thedotmack/claude-mem"/[0-9]*/ "$_C/plugins/cache/thedotmack/claude-mem"/[0-9]*/ 2>/dev/null); _CANDIDATES+=("$_C/plugins/marketplaces/thedotmack/plugin"); _P=""; for _R in "${_CANDIDATES[@]}"; do _R="${_R%/}"; [ -d "$_R/plugin/scripts" ] && _Q="$_R/plugin" || _Q="$_R"; if [ -f "$_Q/scripts/mcp-server.cjs" ]; then _P="$_Q"; break; fi; done; [ -n "$_P" ] || { echo "claude-mem: mcp server not found" >&2; exit 1; }; exec node "$_P/scripts/mcp-server.cjs"
